purpose: Display complete structured records in a scrollable, fullscreen-capable table without model transcription or Markdown truncation.

semanticChannels.semantics: all input records; no implicit sample/filter
exact source field path, including nested objects

payloadShape.title: optional table title; do not repeat in surrounding Markdown
payloadShape.rows: optional inline array of records, mutually exclusive with dataSource
payloadShape.height: scroll window max height in px, default 360, range 180..1000
payloadShape.locale: optional BCP47 locale, default inferred zh-CN/en-US from headers/title
payloadShape.financialMarket: US|CN|HK|international; required for role=change, independent of theme and language

fileInputs.payload: --payload reads a small JSON config; dataSource reads the source JSON directly. Relative source paths resolve from invocation cwd. No HTTP or model-generated transcription.
fileInputs.recordsPath: array of exact keys selecting records; [] selects a root array
fileInputs.field: dot-separated field path, or an array of exact keys when a key contains a dot
fileInputs.sourceCoverage: All records and selected columns are embedded in the standalone HTML. Browser row virtualization does not remove source records. No hard row cap, default sample, pagination loss or silent filtering. Upstream partial API coverage remains partial; renderer completeness only applies to its input.
fileInputs.provenance: receipt.fileSource includes SHA-256, selected record count, recordsPath and projected field paths; saved normalized payload includes the same source metadata

columnContract.type: text|number|percent|date. Text is left aligned, numeric/percent right aligned; optional align left|right|center overrides.
columnContract.number: Display formatting only: digits optionally 0..12, default max 6 fractional digits; prefix/suffix optional. Numeric strings format only if finite; other values retain text, never become zero.
columnContract.percent: Values are already percentage numbers (4.2 becomes 4.2%), never implicitly multiply by 100. Convert source fractions explicitly upstream when required.
columnContract.date: Formats YYYYMMDD as YYYY-MM-DD and replaces ISO T separator with a space. No timezone conversion or inferred source timezone.
columnContract.missing: null renders —; zero and false remain actual values; absent mapped fields fail with row/path details rather than silently discard data.
columnContract.longValues: Cells are selectable single-line text without hover tooltips; complete values remain embedded. Verified links open in a new tab; no detail dialog.
columnContract.sorting: First click sorts descending, next ascending; switching columns starts descending. Only the active header shows one highlighted directional arrow. Sorting covers all source rows, nulls last.
columnContract.role: data (default), index or change. index hides its visible header, uses a compact 40px default width (28..80), small muted text and 4px cell side padding. It preserves supplied ordinal/rank values during sorting. change is only for verified signed price/return changes, not all percentages; requires explicit financialMarket.

link.urlField: Exact source field path with a verified HTTPS URL; null/unsafe URLs remain plain text.
link.behavior: Use either {urlField} or {keyField,lookup}. Join offline, never fetch pages or construct an exchange/slug from a bare ticker. Conflicting catalog identities remain unlinked. Links open a new tab and show a dashed underline on hover/focus. Whole rows and plain cells remain non-clickable.

columnContract.sizing: Measure formatted content and headers; compact index and short columns stay fixed, the widest text column receives spare width. Narrow screens scroll horizontally.
columnContract.instrumentNameLinks: A name/companyName/securityName/instrumentName field without explicit link mapping shares an existing unambiguous HTTPS URL from the same row symbol/ticker/code column. Never constructs URLs; explicit missing/ambiguous mappings remain plain text.

modelInstructions: For structured records, rankings, lists or screening results requested as a table, prefer this component without requiring the user to name a component or say no Markdown. Explicit Markdown/plain-text requests take priority. Small prose-only concept or option comparisons may use Markdown. Source retrieval scope remains the user/model decision.

Use dataSource with already-fetched JSON for complete lists, detail tables, many rows, or a user request for all records. The model supplies only the path, recordsPath and column mappings; do not copy a large dataset into CLI/Markdown.
This is a generic table renderer, not a data provider. Fetch trustworthy data first. Use an existing transformation tool for derived metrics, explicit filtering or aggregation.
Choose columns and formats from actual source fields, values and units. Keep percentages and currencies faithful. Do not invent rows or fill missing values with zero.
The component renders the table, sticky header, local sorting and all rows through its own scroll window; do not repeat the same table as Markdown or create custom HTML for these supported features.

Fullscreen is available in the upper-right toolbar. Normal mode scrolls only within the bounded window; fullscreen expands the table without refetching. Local sorting does not change the source; cells have no click action or dialog.
A large table can expose every input record but cannot create data the upstream API did not fetch. Preserve upstream pagination/coverage limitations in the answer.

Choose semantic roles from actual fields and user intent. Mark ordinal columns role=index; mark signed price/return change columns role=change with explicit financialMarket. For a ticker and its display name map the same verified source URL or catalog identity. Preserve source rank and numbers, and do not color ordinary percentage metrics.

agentContract.input: Pass --payload with a small JSON configuration using dataSource.path/recordsPath and columns[].field/label/type, or rows for small inline records. Optional height (180..1000, default360), locale, theme light|dark; column type text|number|percent|date, digits0..12, prefix/suffix, width80..640 (index28..80, default40). Relative source paths resolve from invocation cwd. --output must be a standalone HTML path. No axes or series are required. Set role=index on ordinal/rank columns. Set role=change only on signed price/return changes and provide financialMarket (US: green up/red down; CN/HK: red up/green down). Supply verified links via column.link.urlField or an offline lookup. Never color fees/yields/ratios merely because they are percentages.
agentContract.output: Complete source records, bounded scrolling, sticky headers, fullscreen, sorting all records, plain text cells without click actions. Do not repeat the same data as a Markdown table.
agentContract.coverage: Renderer completeness covers its input file only; it does not fetch missing upstream pages. Source SHA-256 and selected row count are returned.

presentation.markdownPolicy: The table component already presents these input records and selected fields. Do not repeat them as a Markdown table, row-by-row list or duplicate title. Add conclusions, comparisons and material limitations in prose. Honor an explicit user request for Markdown or plain text.
presentation.scope: Input records and selected fields only; rendering a file does not prove that upstream pagination is complete.

columnSemantics.role: index hides the label and uses small muted text/compact width; change applies signed market colors; data stays neutral.
columnSemantics.financialMarket: Explicit US|CN|HK|international. Language and theme never choose color direction.

lookup.path: path to an already-verified local catalog

columnSemantics.safety: Do not guess market/exchange/URL; missing or ambiguous verified identities remain plain text. Fee/ordinary percentage columns stay role=data.

verifiedCatalogExample.availability: Optional existing AInvest Web navigation catalog. Match asset_type to the actual source (etf or stock); only use when installed/readable. If unavailable, use verified URL fields or that navigation skill. No guessed exchange/slug or remote fetch inside renderer.
